preText: 7:54pm The players are out in the middle, and you can sense the excitement among those at the venue. Suresh Kumar to open the batting, alongside Sujay. Warrier has the new ball for the Dragons. Let's play! 7:50pm Not a big surprise that Ashwin opted to field first after winning the toss. There could be some moisture in the surface and with further showers being forecast, bowling first is the safer bet. And the last time the Dragons played the Kings, they chased and won. The Kings, on the other hand, will have the advantage of putting runs on the board. One change for them, with Ram Arvindh replacing Vignesh, who is a part of the subs bench. Kovai Kings XI: Suresh Kumar, S Sujay, Sai Sudharsan, Shahrukh Khan (capt), U Mukilesh, Ram Arvindh, Atheeq Ur Rahman, M Mohammed, M Siddharth, Jhathavedh Subramanyan, V Yudheesvaran KK bench: Gowtham Thamarai Kannan, R Divakar, G Vignesh, P Vidyuth Dindigul Dragons XI: Vimal Khumar, Sarath Kumar, Baba Indrajith (wk), Boopathi Kumar, R Ashwin (capt), Suboth Bhati, Varun Chakravarthy, P Vignesh, S Dinesh Raj, Sandeep Warrier, VP Diran DD bench: Shivam Singh, K Aashiq, Om Nitin, G Kishoor 7:40pm Dindigul Dragons have won the toss and they have elected to field first. 7:34pm We have more news coming through. The toss will happen at 7:40pm local time, with the first ball scheduled to be bowled at 7:55pm local time. All of this, of course, is contingent to no further rain. 7:24pm Good news, folks. The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. The toss is slated to take place at 7:40pm local time. 7:10pm Still drizzling at the venue, and it seems to be that kind of a day. Fingers crossed that it passes and we can have some action soon. 6:48pm The toss was scheduled to have happened a few minutes ago but the news from Chepauk is that it is raining, and that the toss has not taken place yet. The covers are in place too. 6:40pm The Kovai Kings have lost just one game so far this season. But that defeat was to the Dindigul Dragons. Can the Dragons do the double over them or will the Kings hit back? R Ashwin has been in sparkling form with the bat for the Dragons, and comes into this game on the back of successive half-centuries - both of them coming at a brisk rate. And this seems to be the culmination of a concerted effort by him behind the scenes to widen his game, which he talks about in more detail here. 6:15pm Kovai Kings. The defending champions. Going for a three-peat. Boasting a squad that, on paper, rivals anyone and everyone in the Tamil Nadu Premier League, led by a skipper who has thrilled with his all-round abilities. They have, since the start of this season, been the team to beat. And they are quite possibly still the team to beat tonight. Dindigul Dragons. The challengers. A team that has not yet won the TNPL. But has a genuine match-winner and master tactician at the helm. He too has brought his all-round A-game to the fore, especially in the playoffs and having won two on the bounce to make it here, they will want to make it three in a row. Not just to break their TNPL duck, but also to deny the Kovai Kings. So, this is it. The final of the TNPL. Two sides who have eyes on winning the big prize and will likely pull out all the stops to get there. But only one of these two will etch themselves into TNPL folklore tonight and have a chapter to themselves when the competition is chronicled - either as only the second to win three TNPLs on the spin, or as a new winner. Hello and welcome to ESPNcricinfo's live coverage of the TNPL. The stage is set. One team will end the night in dreamland, while the other will drift away towards disappointment. A proper high-stakes, high-drama (potentially), winner-takes-all contest, so without further ado, let's get stuck into the action!
text: big appeal first up but turned down! Fullish delivery that starts on off stump and shapes back in nicely. Sujay falls across and then seems to play all over it. Might have gotten an inside edge before the ball hit the pads
